title: Security When the Workforce Goes Remote

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: We are in the midst of a rapid and unprecedented shift to remote work.
reader_summary.overview: We are in the midst of a rapid and unprecedented shift to remote work. What does it mean for security when the airgap between work and life is gone? And what should security professionals as well as individual workers be doing to protect themselves and their companies?

key_points.text: In this podcast, a16z security expert Joel de la Garza breaks down the current risks and how to defend against them.
But beyond just immediate security needs, he explains what bigger transformations may be happening, most notably a shift from the traditional hub-and-spoke.
a16z and its affiliates may maintain investments in the companies discussed.
